items.title: the language server's peak RSS on the single-document leaf row grows +40..160 MB at S7b (496-567 -> 535-659 MB) from glibc per-thread ARENA FRAGMENTATION of the held walk's larger transient working set, not retained data - `MALLOC_ARENA_MAX=1` closes the gap (506 vs 512); vilan-lsp should set the arena limit itself at start (mallopt / M_ARENA_MAX), measured at the seal
items.discussion: incr-52a's C1 report (Order 52; owner question 4): the growth lands BETWEEN analyses, the checked cache totals 2.3 MB; M142 (S7b's held walk); M67 (the base-cache budget - a different thing: retained worlds); E294; N166 (the seal's RSS gate is on the CLI's cold check, not the server's VmHWM - lsp-latency's VmHWM column is the reading); E121's rows
items.body: A one-liner in vilan-lsp's main (glibc only, behind a cfg): `mallopt(M_ARENA_MAX, 1)` (or 2) before the runtime starts, or the equivalent env default documented for other allocators; re-measure the seven rows' VmHWM column at the seal against the base (the leaf row +40..160 MB today; expected back within noise) and the keystroke CPU columns unchanged (a single arena serializes allocation across threads - the server's analysis is mostly one thread, but say what the pause row reads). Pin: none runnable in CI (an RSS reading); the seal's VmHWM column is the record. Sizing XS (vilan-lsp main.rs).
